subject: a recipe that a small Israeli food business wants to publish on its page

fields.prompt: the recipe's name, in Hebrew, as the text gives it
one or two plain Hebrew sentences on what is special about the recipe, only from the text
one ingredient per item, with its amount, as written
one step per item, in order, as written
minutes of hands-on work, only if the text gives a number
minutes in the oven or on the stove, only if the text gives a number
how many people or pieces, only if the text gives a number
numbers from the owner's product list below for products the recipe uses; never a number not in the list
